name: DataDEL
description: DataDEL is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating data-effective learning in medical foundation models, including a large dataset from multiple medical centers, a baseline method (MedDEL), and a new evaluation metric (NormDEL) to measure data efficiency.
reputation: A specialized benchmark with limited but growing interest in medical foundation model evaluation, especially for data-efficiency studies.
notes: Benchmark addresses lack of standards in medical data-effective learning; baseline achieves comparable performance with only 5% of original data.
